input:
Write 5 emails of category `mdm_request`, one per slot below, each with its label as described in the brief. Every email must be different in sender, organisation, products and wording.

Slots:
1. domain customer. English, internal from a QTS sales rep in Vietnam: please create a new customer, a hospital in Da Nang, with its tax code (MST) and address; no contact email given.
2. domain customer. Bahasa Indonesia, from an outside clinic asking to be registered as a customer so they can buy test kits; gives its NPWP and a contact email; no address.
3. domain vendor. English, from Lives Group procurement: onboard a new logistics supplier in Malaysia; gives SSM number, address and contact email; says bank details will come separately on the secure form.
4. domain item. English, from an SPD product manager: create a new IVD rapid test item (not in the catalogue) to sell in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand; gives only the Singapore registration number.
5. domain cost_center. English, short, from finance: new cost center for the QTG Vietnam service team, effective 1 November 2026.

emails.body:
Hi team,

Can you please open a new customer account for Bệnh viện Đa khoa Hải Châu in Da Nang? MST 0401234567. Address: 38 Nguyen Van Linh, Hai Chau District, Da Nang. They are interested in our biosafety cabinet and a centrifuge, quotation to follow once the account is ready. I don't have a contact email for their procurement yet, will send it later.

Thanks,
Minh Tuan
Sales Executive, QTS Vietnam
+84 90 555 0142

Rachel Ong
Product Manager, SPD
